inspection_method: shallow git clone plus README, expanded meta/readme page, Eleventy content tree, package scripts, collection filters, computed data, search and navigation components

anchors.why: States this is a personal Eleventy wiki shared for adaptation, not a maintained open-source product.
Documents installation, content directory structure, features, search modes, computed data, TOC, navigation, and tradeoffs.
Stores wiki content in nested Markdown folders under a single content root.
Extracts outbound links, deduplicates them, counts domains, and records source page information.
Builds ordered page collections with featured pages and page index metadata.
Computes navigation, breadcrumbs, source/history links, link counts, content indexes, and file paths.

known_limits: The author explicitly limits maintenance/open-source expectations.
Link extraction and domain counts are useful diagnostics but not source quality or evidence support.
External analytics/API integration should remain optional and scoped.
